purpose: Teach: 儲かっ/聴ける/リタイア/小雨/平ら/殴っ/呑ん/止めよ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお仕事が儲かったみたいよ
lines.en: Sho, it looks like your father's business did quite well.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle rise on the observation. Relaxed pace, like sharing good news naturally over daily routine. Slight contentment underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの歌が聴けるの楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm really looking forward to Dad singing for us.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick tempo. Genuine excitement without performing it — the simple joy of a child anticipating something. Slight lean-in on 'singing'.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんはリタイア後、悠々自適よ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is enjoying a very comfortable retirement.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative tone. Slower pace. A hint of wistfulness — reflecting on what ease looks like. Voice settles on the final phrase, like she's thinking about the concept.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、今日は小雨だから傘を持って行くよ
lines.en: Mom, since it's drizzling today, I'm going to take an umbrella with me.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact delivery. Clear and straightforward. A touch of quiet responsibility — he's thinking ahead without fussing about it. Steady, assured.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが砂場を平らにして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father kindly smoothed out the sandbox for us.
lines.style: Gentle appreciation in the voice. Quiet warmth — noticing a small act of care. Slow pace, tender. The kindness of acknowledging what someone did without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、友達と喧嘩で殴ったりしないって約束するよ
lines.en: Mom, I promise I won't hit my friends or get into fights.
lines.style: Serious, earnest tone. Voice steady and committed — he means this. No hesitation, but not stiff either. A six-year-old making a pledge he wants to keep. Slight pause before the promise itself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが薬を呑んでお休みになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father took his medicine and is resting now.
lines.style: Calm, reassuring tone. Even pacing. Practical information delivered with quiet care — letting him know everything is in order. No alarm, just straightforward maternal attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、喧嘩は止めようって決めたよ
lines.en: Mom, I've decided to stop fighting with people.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slower tempo, thoughtful. The voice of a small child who has come to a real decision. Not defiant — sincere and resolved. Slight softness underneath, like he's being brave.
